strings.mdKbSmart: • Akwatin maɓalli na Smart: yana duba akwatin maɓalli na yanzu akan jerin sokewar Google (CRL) kuma yana gwada hanyoyin da yawa har sai ya sami akwatin maɓalli mai inganci, tare da madadin atomatik da sake kunna sabis na Google. Yana aiki akan kowane famfo kuma yana buƙatar intanet (minti 1-3).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox from network: downloads a keybox from the official repository (GitHub) and saves it to /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Needs internet and takes 1-3 minutes. Used when the smart fetch fails or when the keybox was changed manually.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP diagnosis: checks the available Remote Key Provisioning modules, inspects the TEE attestation certificate version, and shows the KmInstallKeybox tool state. Changes nothing — a plain device status view.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine check (read-only): shows Widevine level indicators (L1/L3) from dumpsys, DRM (IDM) key-file presence, and related system properties. Modifies nothing at all.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Yana gyara al'amuran shaida lokacin da wucewa ta atomatik ta gaza. Kowane gudu yana buga ingantaccen layin nasara/ gazawa.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Cikakken RKP gyara: yana gudanar da sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh cikakke. Yana sarrafa lokuta masu wuya kuma yana ɗaukar tsayi. Wani tabbataccen sakamako yana bayyana a ƙarshe.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Sake saitin GMS: yana share bayanan Play Store da Google (GMS+GSF) kuma yana sake kunna na'urar ta atomatik. Don taurin kai kawai - ba ya taɓa hotunanku ko fayilolinku.
strings.mdCertify: • Takaddun shaida na wasa: yana duba yanayin shaidar shaidar RKP na na'urar kuma ya sake saita kaddarorin shaidar idan an buƙata. Ba ya taɓa bayanan mai amfani.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER repair: fixes Google services framework (SOTER) issues related to device attestation. Used for some devices that rely on SOTER instead of Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Aiwatar da PIF: yana gudanar da sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh karfi. Yana aiki da zaɓaɓɓen yatsa (na gida/ci gaba) kuma yana sabunta fayilolin pif.prop/pif.json. Wani tabbataccen sakamako yana bayyana a cikin log ɗin.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF duba: yana nuna yanayin injin da aka shigar, fayilolin sawun yatsa (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), da kuma rajistan ayyukan. Duba kawai - ba ya canza komai.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: yana gudanar da sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Yana fitar da sabuwar Canary Engine don tabbatar da dacewa tare da takaddun RKP na wajibi (Fabrairu 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Engine diagnosis: checks the TrickyStoreOSS state (pid, logs), the keybox files (active vs user), the real vs spoofed device fingerprint, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP keys. Diagnostic display only.
strings.hintKbSlots: Tsarin yana sarrafa ramukan akwatin maɓalli guda biyu: na farko (tsarki, ba a taɓa gogewa ba) da na sakandare (ajiyayyen). Wannan shafin yana nuna wanne ramin ke aiki, yana canza fifiko, ko haɓaka matakin sakandare zuwa firamare akan buƙatun bayyane - tare da madogarawa da cikakken log.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Fahimtar Mutunci: bincika maɓallin shigo da TEE, alluran ɗakin karatu a cikin keystore2, matsayin sokewa (CRL), lissafin kariya-jerin da jihar RKP. Karanta-kawai - ba ya canza kome.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe re-apply:

• Ana sake gina lissafin kariya daga kowane app ɗin da aka shigar.
• An sake amfani da Layer na dacewa da al'ada. Ba a taɓa taɓa akwatin maɓalli ba.

Ci gaba?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Ramin akwatin maɓalli: yana nuna yanayin guraben firamare da sakandare kuma yana canza fifiko tsakanin su. Primary (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) ana kiyaye shi koyaushe kuma ba'a goge shi ba. Ƙaddamar da sakandare zuwa firamare yana buƙatar tabbatarwa bayyane.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Haɓaka matakin sakandare zuwa firamare:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml ya zama babban abun ciki na farko.
• Ana ajiye firamare na yanzu azaman madadin kafin maye gurbin.
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 share secondry slot:
#
• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml za'a cire.
• Ba'a taɓa primary ɗin ba.

Ci gaba?
